prompt:
Create fifteen complete isolated sprite poses of Dorian Mycel on true transparent RGBA, strict 5-column by 3-row row-major atlas. Every person fully inside canvas with margin. Clean outlined 1990s arcade art. No ball or object whatsoever; game ball is separate. No hoop, floor, court, background, text, shadow, effects, lines, logos or extra people.

Use both attached identity images exactly: compact athletic adult human, warm medium-brown skin, clean-shaven expressive face, strong brows, short vivid-purple curls, purple Chicago Condas kit with silver/lavender trim, dark knee pads, purple wristbands, purple/silver shoes. No identity or anatomy changes; two arms and legs.

DUNK-SCYTHE: one continuous right-facing running approach, jump and sweeping diagonal scythe dunk. With empty hand miming the ball, Dorian sweeps low and behind his hip, then cuts across his body on a diagonal up and forward, reaches peak, finishes and lands. Motion is a clear scythe-like low-to-high arc. 0 approach; 1 accelerate; 2 plants; 3 hand sweeps low across waist; 4 arm carries unseen ball behind hip; 5 launches while sweeping upward; 6 airborne, arm crosses chest; 7 diagonal sweep rises; 8 reaches high across body; 9 peak; 10 forward scoring finish; 11 follow-through; 12 descend; 13 low landing; 14 recover. Fifteen unique full-body frames; moderate compact silhouettes and clear empty margins; no ball drawn.
ballPolicy: Dorian-specific separate basketball follows the ball-miming body motion and releases/grabs on the reviewed event frame. Never paint a ball into the poses. Track length: 15.

cleanup.method: alpha-connected component isolation and nearest-pixel reassignment

review.reviewNotes: 15 distinct complete Dorian dunk-scythe poses. Warm brown skin, short dense vivid-purple curls, compact adult human anatomy, strong brows and the purple/silver Chicago Condas kit remain consistent. The separate Dorian ball follows the documented dunk-scythe track.
